name: Wiki dream
ownerWords:
llm wiki duty more like "keep it in sync", "organized to principles" you know claude's Dream feature? look it up. i expected a daily job that cleans wiki, find anti-patterns agent mistakes alot, then fixes related skills so that doesn't happen again.
the main wiki all articles and whcih articles exist itself should always be up to date
goal: The wiki matches the repo and itself, and agent mistakes stop repeating. Each target is 0 because the owner asked that the wiki 'always be up to date' and skills be fixed 'so that doesn't happen again'; the 10-15 run cleared 50 missing dates and judged 30 page pairs in one go. A mistake fix gets one daily run, since the 10-13 rules landed 22 h after their draft.

metrics.label: Wiki problems (unlisted pages, broken links, missing dates, stale pages)
Repeated agent mistakes with no skill or code fix after a day
Fixed agent mistakes that came back within 7 days
Page pairs that may cover one topic, not yet checked

onMiss: Follow auto-sns-agent's playbook (node scripts/skills/read-skill.mjs apps/llm-wiki/references/wiki-dream.md) and the ledger in this chat's duties folder. Fix every flagged item this run, headline first, one subagent per page, pair or class, with no daily cap; where the playbook caps a day or stops at a plan step, this wins, so fix the playbook too. An enforcement gap gets a check in code with a test from a fix job (rlm.create_session). A rule waiting on a CI probe asks the chat for a slot with its object sha. Then rerun the precheck (scripts/duties/wiki-dream.ts in sieun-pi components/user-history) and go again until every metric is 0, or name the blocker and whose it is. A miscount gets a fix in wiki-dream.ts with a test. Commits use the scope wiki-dream; never push sieun/dev or sieun-pi. Report each metric before and after with the commits; a quiet day sends nothing.
